sources.name: Ludii -- The Ludemic General Game System
Flow-Lenia: Towards open-ended evolution in cellular automata through mass conservation and parameter localization
sources.notes: Mass-conserving Lenia where rule parameters are carried by matter, so multiple species with different local rules coexist, interact and mix.

sources.name: Gran Turismo Sophy 2.0 permanently added to Gran Turismo 7
sources.notes: Spec II update; PS5 only; nine tracks and 340 cars (95% of car models) versus four cars and four tracks before; selected as Rival AI in Quick Race only.

sources.name: Gran Turismo Sophy Race Together event in Gran Turismo 7
sources.notes: Time-limited event in Update 1.29: four races against GT Sophy cars of different performance at Beginner, Intermediate, and Expert levels, plus a 1vs1 mode.

sources.name: Democracy 4 comes to consoles
sources.notes: Developer blog post announcing Democracy 4: Console Edition for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox on 2024-06-05.

sources.name: The Powder Toy official site
sources.notes: Simulates air pressure and velocity, heat, and gravity; electronics and wiring; community save browser; Lua API; Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, browser; GPL source on GitHub.

sources.name: Probabilistic weather forecasting with machine learning
sources.notes: GenCast diffusion ensemble, 0.25 degree, 12-hour steps, 15-day horizon; 50-member ensembles; more skillful than ECMWF ENS on 97.2% of 1,320 targets; one 15-day forecast in about 8 minutes on a TPUv5.

sources.name: Needs
sources.notes: 21 general prisoner needs with satisfying objects and durations; charge 1 to 10 with a side effect at 10; unmet needs may cause fights, escape attempts, riots, or criminal insanity; report colors from green to red.

sources.name: Suck Up! Terms of Service
sources.notes: Last updated 2023-12-05; Proxima Enterprises Inc.; in-game Tokens exchanged for use of an AI model, with GPT 3.5 and Llama 2 as examples; in-game messages may be collected for research and development.

sources.name: Suck Up! official site
sources.notes: Copyright Proxima Enterprises Inc.; describes the website build as Early Access and the Steam version as the 1.0 release with Workshop support; players craft character personalities and behaviors.

sources.name: Moodles
sources.notes: Moodle list and effects: hungry, thirsty, panic, bored, stressed, unhappy, heavy load, endurance, tired, hyperthermia, hypothermia, windchill, wet, injured, pain, bleeding, has a cold, sick; zombie infection always fatal in an unmodified game.

sources.name: ALPHA RELEASE! WHOO!
sources.notes: Public release of the free Proof of Concept Demo Alpha 0.4.0 (XNA); adjustable simulation speed, creature and DNA inspection, species statistics over time, Tree of Life view, move, feed, and remove tools, bundled Mod Maker.

sources.name: Species 0.7.0 Released!
sources.notes: Free alpha; skeleton analyzed for internal forces and torques to charge energy costs; creatures eat only within head reach; rovers feed or kill by genetic distance to a target genome and can be programmed to deforest or fertilize; climate control devices make cold, hot, fertile, or dead ground; fences.

sources.name: Devblog #5: Thrive vs Species
sources.notes: Describes Species (single developer Quasar, free alpha) genes stored as numbers; most mutations add a random value in [-1, 1] times a modifier for background mutation rate and radiation; species defined by interbreeding within genetic distance, splitting only when intermediates die out; stamina from joint torques.

sources.name: AI Storytellers
sources.notes: Storytellers weigh colony wealth, colonist and animal counts, recent deaths or wounds, and time since the last major event. Incident chance = base chance x population-intent factor (8.0 at 0 colonists falling to -1.0 at 20). Cassandra escalates in cycles, Phoebe leaves longer gaps, Randy follows no pattern and has a 0.20 minimum factor.

sources.name: Backstories
sources.notes: All pawns get a childhood backstory; pawns generated at 20 or older also get an adulthood one. Backstories add flat skill modifiers, enable or disable work types, and grant or forbid traits. 25% of regular pawns and all faction leaders first try a fixed player-made bio, else shuffled backstories.

sources.name: Goodwill
sources.notes: Faction goodwill -100 to 100; hostile at -75 or below, ally at 75 or above until it drops to 0; civil outlanders drift into -50..50 (0.4 per day down, 0.2 up); returning a prisoner +12; trade +1 per 500 silver; gifts +1 per 40-160 silver; arresting a visitor sets -75; pirates fixed at -100; calling a caravan costs 15.

sources.name: Health
sources.notes: Capacities from body parts: consciousness below 30% keeps a pawn from waking; moving below 15% incapacitates; each arm gives half of manipulation; blood pumping or digestion at 0% is fatal; poor tending raises scarring and infection risk; bionic leg +12.5% moving; base healing 8 damage per day.

sources.name: Inspiration
sources.notes: Inspirations need mood above 49%; mean days between them = 410 - 400 x mood fraction (210 at 50%, 10 at 100%); one at a time; weighted by passion 1, 2.5, 5; inspired creativity raises one item two quality levels; inspired trade +18% prices; work frenzy x1.8 work speed; most last 8 days.

sources.name: Mental break
sources.notes: Base thresholds minor 35%, major 20% (4/7 of minor), extreme 5% (1/7 of minor); traits shift the minor threshold, capped 1-50%; mean time between breaks below each threshold about 4 days (minor), 0.8 (major), 0.5 (extreme).

sources.name: Mood
sources.notes: Mood 0-100% is base mood plus net thoughts; base mood by difficulty from 22 to 42; the bar moves toward its target at up to +12 per hour rising and -8 per hour falling and pauses while asleep; break risk bands below 35%, 20%, 5%.

sources.name: Raid points
sources.notes: Raid points = (wealth points + pawn points) x threat scale x starting factor x adaptation factor, capped at 10,000, minimum 35. Storyteller wealth counts items, creatures, and 50% of buildings; wealth points 0 at 14,000 up to 4,200 at 1,000,000; 15-200 points per colonist; threat scale 0.1-2.2 by preset; starting factor 0.7 through day 10; adaptation factor about 0.4-1.47, lowered by deaths and downings.

sources.name: Room
sources.notes: Rooms enclosed by walls, doors, vents, coolers, or natural rock; max 36 map regions or 5,184 tiles; roles scored from contents (dining 12 per table, workshop 27 per workbench, bedroom invalid with more than one unassigned bed); beauty = total beauty / weighted size (size if >40, else 20 + size/2); impressiveness combines wealth, beauty, space, and cleanliness with log scaling and min-weighting.

sources.name: Skills
sources.notes: Levels 0-20; XP to next level 1,000 at level 0 rising to 30,000 at 19; passion learning 35%, 100%, 150% and +8 or +14 mood during related work; decay above level 9 from 30 to 3,600 XP per day; daily cap 4,000 XP per skill, then gains x20%; construction speed 50% plus 15% per level; incapable work types.

sources.name: Social
sources.notes: Opinion -100 to 100; rival below -20, friend above 20; chitchat about +0.66 stacking to +10; deep talk +15, insult -15, slight -5 for 20 days; insult odds up to 6x at -100 opinion; social fight 4% per insult; parent +30, sibling +20; lover +35, spouse +30, ex -15, breakup -50; romance attempts every 12 days for pawns over 16, beauty x0.3 to x2.3; rebuff -10 and -15.

sources.name: Stockpile
sources.notes: Stockpile priorities low, normal, preferred, important, critical; haulers bring items to higher-priority stockpiles with space, including items already stored in lower ones.

sources.name: Thoughts
sources.notes: Memory thoughts list mood effect, expiry in days, stack limit, and stack multiplier (mostly 0.75). Examples: Colonist lost 6 days, 5 stacks; My son died -20 for 30 days; My friend died -10 for 20 days, scaled by relation; expectations +18 (low) to -12 (royal); lavish meal +12, raw food -7; some traits nullify thoughts.

sources.name: Time
sources.notes: 60 ticks per second at normal speed; speeds x3, x6, and x15 (ultrafast only in development mode); runs as close to target as hardware allows; 2,500 ticks per hour, 60,000 per day; 15-day quadrums, 4 per 60-day year; Space pauses.

sources.name: Work
sources.notes: Work tab in standard mode (checkmarks, columns further left more important) or manual priorities 1-4; all available work at one priority is done before the next; ties resolve left to right; blank cells never done; incapable types excluded; allowed areas restrict where work is taken.

sources.name: Cube: A Roblox View of 3D Intelligence
sources.notes: 3D shape tokenizer as foundation for Roblox developers; text-to-shape, shape-to-text, text-to-scene; LLM integration for scene reasoning.

sources.name: Roblox Cube repository
sources.notes: Cube 3D v0.1 2025-03, v0.5 2025-07 (bounding-box conditioning, ~2.8M additional synthetic assets), CubePart 2026-05 (part-controllable, usable with animation, physics, scripts); OBJ output; 16-24 GB VRAM.

sources.name: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
sources.notes: FunSearch: frozen LLM proposes programs, evaluator scores them, island-based program database; cap set of size 512 in dimension 8; online bin-packing heuristics beat first fit and best fit.

sources.name: Predicting Game Difficulty and Churn Without Players
sources.notes: Deep RL agents estimate level difficulty in Angry Birds Dream Blast; a population model with skill, persistence, and boredom predicts per-level pass and churn rates.

sources.name: How a single game trailer turned the tide for Factorio
sources.notes: After the February 2013 Indiegogo campaign the team had a purchasable alpha version on sale; alpha sales barely covered living expenses for almost a year.

sources.name: Learning to Simulate Complex Physics with Graph Networks
sources.notes: GNS: particles as graph nodes with learned message passing for fluids, rigid solids, deformables; trained on one-step targets, generalizes to thousands of steps and 10x more particles; training noise limits drift.

sources.name: Alternate recipes
sources.notes: 106 alternate recipes; each crash-site Hard Drive scanned in the MAM offers a choice of two; drives can be stored in a library and re-rolled once; a few alternates come from MAM research instead.

sources.name: Blueprint Designer
sources.notes: Introduced in patch 0.7.0.0; Mk.1 (40 x 40 m) unlocks at Tier 4, Mk.2 and Mk.3 added in 1.0; saved blueprints appear in a build-menu tab and draw materials from the designer's storage then the player's inventory.

sources.name: Clock speed
sources.notes: Clock speed settable from 1% to 250%; each Power Shard raises the cap by 50% up to three shards; power scales nonlinearly with exponent 1.321928 (changed from 1.6 in 0.7.0.0), so 250% draws 335.77% of base power.

sources.name: Conveyor Belts
sources.notes: Belt throughput Mk.1 to Mk.6: 60, 120, 270, 480, 780, and 1,200 items per minute.

sources.name: Drone
sources.notes: Drones provide long-range low-throughput transport between a home Drone Port and one linked port; 9 inventory slots; fuelled by batteries or packaged fuels, with faster speeds for higher-value fuel; one drone unloads at a time.

sources.name: Pipeline
sources.notes: Pipeline Mk.1 carries 300 m3/min and Mk.2 600 m3/min; liquids need head lift (about 1.3 m to fill a level pipe); pumps add head lift; gases need none.

sources.name: Power
sources.notes: A grid trips when consumption exceeds production and Power Storage is empty, stopping every connected building until the fuse is reset; buildings do not slow during shortages; Power Storage holds 100 MWh; generators from 30 MW (Biomass Burner) to 2,500 MW (Nuclear Power Plant); idle buildings draw 0.1 MW.

sources.name: Resource node
sources.notes: All resource nodes are infinite; purity multipliers impure 0.5x, normal 1.0x, pure 2.0x.

sources.name: Space Elevator
sources.notes: Five Project Assembly phases unlock tiers 3-4, 5-6, 7-8, 9, and the ending; phase 1 needs 50 Smart Plating, phase 5 needs Nuclear Pasta, Biochemical Sculptors, AI Expansion Servers, and Ballistic Warp Drives; progress is shared in multiplayer; completing phase 5 launches Project Assembly.

sources.name: Student of Games: A unified learning algorithm for both perfect and imperfect information games
sources.notes: Guided search, self-play learning, and game-theoretic reasoning in one sound algorithm; strong in chess and Go, beat the strongest open heads-up no-limit agent, and beat the prior best Scotland Yard agent.

sources.name: Mastering Atari, Go, chess and shogi by planning with a learned model
sources.notes: MuZero: learned representation, dynamics, and prediction networks planned over with MCTS, without being given the rules; preprint November 2019.

sources.name: OUT NOW: Autonauts (Denki)
sources.notes: Created by Gary Penn and Aaron Puzey at Denki; robots controlled with a Scratch-inspired visual language; Colonise, Free, and Creative modes; full release added a campaign, transport, animal husbandry, multipart bots, and expanded research.

sources.name: Screeps blog: Indiegogo updates, November 2014 to February 2015
sources.notes: Paginated blog listing (position may shift). In late 2014 the browser Simulation mode was the playable version, called 'only a demo' on 2014-11-25; the Indiegogo campaign ended 2014-12-31; a ranked Survival mode open to all was announced live on 2015-01-21.

sources.name: Game situation review: December 11, 2015
sources.notes: States 'A year has passed since the initial launch of the game' and introduces the Public Test Realm; a January 2016 post on the same page notes a Steam version giving lifetime MMO access with a 10 CPU limit.

sources.name: Screeps private server released!
sources.notes: Announces the open-source private server and that the game would exit Steam Early Access with a full release on 16 November 2016.

sources.name: Control
sources.notes: Room Controller Levels 1-8 unlock spawns, extensions, towers, storage, links, labs, terminal, factory, observer, and nuker at cumulative upgrade energy; unupgraded controllers downgrade; Global Control Level sets claimable rooms and CPU (10 per level up to 300) and is never lost.

sources.name: How does CPU limit work
sources.notes: Per-tick CPU limit (20 without CPU Unlock, otherwise tied to Global Control Level); unused CPU accumulates in a bucket of up to 10,000; a tick may use up to 500 CPU from the bucket; scripts are terminated at the limit.

sources.name: Creeps
sources.notes: Bodies of up to 50 parts (WORK, MOVE, CARRY, ATTACK, RANGED_ATTACK, HEAL, CLAIM, TOUGH); lifespan 1,500 ticks; spawn budget 300 energy plus extensions; non-MOVE parts add fatigue 1/2/10 on road/plain/swamp and each MOVE part removes 2 per tick; 100 hits per part.

sources.name: Understanding game loop, time and ticks
sources.notes: Each player's main module runs once per tick against a fixed game state; commands queue and are applied together at the end of the tick with conflicts resolved by priority; globals are erased between ticks.

sources.name: Introduction
sources.notes: One persistent world of 50x50-cell rooms grouped into shards; plain movement cost 2, swamp 10, road 1; energy sources regenerate every 300 ticks; at most 3 spawns per room; a first spawn grants safe mode.

sources.name: Market
sources.notes: Terminals trade through public buy and sell orders in credits with a 5% order fee; the party executing a deal pays an energy transfer cost that grows with distance; NPC terminals sit at highway crossroads.

sources.name: Crossing the uncanny valley of conversational voice
sources.notes: Conversational Speech Model: Llama-variant backbone (1B, 3B, 8B) plus small decoder over Mimi split-RVQ tokens at 12.5 Hz; about one million hours of mostly English audio. CMOS: no preference vs human without context; human recordings preferred with 90 s of context. No turn-taking modeling; Apache 2.0 release announced.

sources.name: An Extensible, Data-Oriented Architecture for High-Performance, Many-World Simulation
sources.notes: Madrona batch ECS engine. Project page: Hide and Seek over 1.9M steps/s, Overcooked-AI 40M steps/s, Hanabi 20M steps/s (RTX 4090); 2-3 orders of magnitude over open-source CPU baselines, 5-33x over 32-thread CPU baselines.

sources.name: Modding
sources.notes: The game loads mods natively with the ShapezShifter API; mods are published to and auto-downloaded from Steam Workshop.

sources.name: Operator Level
sources.notes: Endless goal lines after milestones and jobs; cost grows exponentially per level (Fluids & Painting starts at 15,000 shapes with 18% growth); levels reward Platform Units, Blueprint Points, and Research Points unless copy/paste is free or the platform limit is off.

sources.name: Shapes
sources.notes: Layers hold 4 parts (6 in the Hexagonal scenario); shapes have 1 to 4 layers (5 in Insane); part types include circle, square, star, diamond, pin, and crystal; nine colors; shape codes list layers bottom to top; floating parts are not allowed; separating crystals shatters them.

sources.name: Space Platforms
sources.notes: Space view chunks correspond to 20x20 machine-view areas; notches (1x4, three levels tall) carry shapes, fluids, or wire signals between platforms; one notch handles up to 12 saturated belts.

sources.name: Trains
sources.notes: Rails carry trains of several colors, each taking its own color's branch at splitters; loaders fill fixed-size packages; shape and fluid wagons hold up to three packages, one per machine level; immediate stops pause about 4 s; unlocked at Milestone 2.

sources.name: OpenEvolve: open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve
sources.notes: Apache-2.0; MAP-Elites and island populations over LLM code edits; works with OpenAI-compatible APIs and local models; project-reported circle-packing replication.

sources.name: Introducing Versu
sources.notes: Launch post: Versu released for iPad on 2013-02-14 by Linden Lab; characters autonomous or human-played; Richard Evans was lead AI designer on The Sims 3.

sources.name: Mastering Chess and Shogi by Self-Play with a General Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
sources.notes: AlphaZero: superhuman chess, shogi, and Go within 24 hours from random play given only the rules; beat a world-champion program in each game.

sources.name: Motive
sources.notes: Community wiki; accessed revision. Lists six motives (Hunger, Bladder, Energy, Social, Hygiene, Fun) in The Sims 3 and The Sims 4 moodlet charts.

sources.name: Sony AI Expands Capabilities of Breakthrough AI Agent Gran Turismo Sophy
sources.notes: GT Sophy 2.1 in GT7 update 1.57 Custom Race: 19 car and track options, lap count, parts upgrades and tuning, adjustable tire and fuel consumption.

sources.name: Offworld Trading Company: Early Access First Impressions
sources.notes: Published 2015-03-18 while the game was on Steam Early Access; four HQ types; auctions for tiles and patents; black market nukes, EMPs, mutinies; stock price falls with debt; buying own stock raises buyout cost.

sources.name: LLM Pruning and Distillation in Practice: The Minitron Approach
sources.notes: Depth and width pruning plus distillation: Llama 3.1 8B to 4B and Mistral NeMo 12B to Mistral-NeMo-Minitron-8B; slight teacher fine-tuning on the distillation set helps when original data is unavailable; weights released.

sources.name: Real-Time Fluid Dynamics for Games
sources.notes: Stable Navier-Stokes solver for games with C code; density step: add source, implicit diffuse via Gauss-Seidel, semi-Lagrangian advect; velocity step adds projection to a divergence-free field via a Poisson solve; stable at arbitrary time steps; real time for reasonable 2D and 3D grids. Venue per common citation; landing page does not name it.

sources.name: Simulating Human Behavior with AI Agents
sources.notes: 1,052 participants; agents replicated GSS responses 85% as accurately as participants replicated their own answers two weeks later; comparable on Big Five, five economic games (dictator, two trust games, public goods, prisoner's dilemma), and five experiments; less biased than earlier simulation methods.

sources.name: Animals
sources.notes: Friendship 0-1000 (petting +15, unfed -20); mood 0-255; mood under 70 may skip production, quality products need mood 150; unfed animals stop producing but do not die; nightly birth check 50% base then about 0.55% per animal; hay for winter; open doors risk wild animal attacks.

sources.name: Bundles
sources.notes: Community Center has six rooms and thirty bundles; room rewards repair the quarry bridge, greenhouse, minecarts, and bus; Joja membership replaces bundles with payments; remixed bundles option; many items are season-specific.

sources.name: Energy
sources.notes: Base max energy 270, +34 per Stardrop to 508; tools cost energy; exhausted at 0 (slower actions); pass out at -15, ending the day, losing 10% of gold up to 1,000g if outside; bed after midnight cuts restoration from 2.5% at 12:10 AM to 50% at 2:00 AM.

sources.name: Weather
sources.notes: Weather types sunny, rain, wind, storm, snow; tomorrow's forecast on the TV; festivals always sunny; no rain in winter without a Rain Totem; lightning can destroy crops and trees unless lightning rods intercept; weather changes which fish can be caught.

sources.name: Friendship
sources.notes: Official community wiki; accessed revision. 250 points per heart, 10 hearts for most villagers, 2-point daily decay without talking, two gifts per week, birthday gifts multiplied by 8, heart events.

sources.name: Eco on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2018-02-06, Strange Loop Games, Early Access section still shown at access. Simulated ecosystem with thousands of plants and animals and dozens of species, cascading effects; meteor set to strike in thirty days; pollution poisons rivers and farms; programmable laws voted and enforced, elections set taxes; player stores, labor contracts, fiat or resource-backed currencies; skill points from varied food and larger homes; 30+ craft tables; single-player and online co-op.

sources.name: Command: Modern Operations on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2019-11-14, Matrix Games, Windows. Features: radar propagation, sensor degradation, terrain masking, sonar thermal layers, weather, ballistics; jamming, comms disruption, anti-radiation strikes; EMCON and weapon release authority doctrine; tactical AI; database of tens of thousands of platforms, sensors, weapons; thousands of active platforms in real time; Lua scripting; scenario editor; 600+ scenarios; Steam Workshop; real-time multiplayer PvP and co-op.

sources.name: Caves of Qud
sources.notes: Early access 2015-07-15, 1.0 2024-12-05; published by Kitfox Games; hybrid handcrafted and procedurally generated world.

sources.name: Farming Simulator 25 on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2024-11-12, GIANTS Software; 25 crop types incl. rice, spinach, peas, green beans; 400+ vehicles and tools from 150+ brands; seven animal types incl. water buffalo and goats; productions; GPS steering; twisters and hail; ground deformation; ModHub.

sources.name: inZOI on Steam
sources.notes: Early access release 2025-03-27 (store date; Wikipedia gives 2025-03-28). Free-will Zois producing rumors, trends, and disease; on-device SLM text prompts influence actions and thoughts; text-to-pattern, 2D-to-3D objects, video-to-motion; Canvas sharing.

sources.name: Where Winds Meet on Steam
sources.notes: Global PC release 2025-11-14. AI disclosure: AI-driven NPC text and voice chat that responds to player input in real time, plus optional AI-assisted character-face generation from uploaded images or audio.

sources.name: Against the Storm on Steam
sources.notes: Eremite Games, Hooded Horse; player is the Viceroy of the Scorched Queen; species with distinct housing, food, luxury, and recreation preferences; reputation per settlement; recurring Blightstorms; resources, upgrades, and experience carry over to upgrade the Smoldering City; six biomes; forest areas with boons and threats.

sources.name: Autonauts
sources.notes: Released 2019-10-17; Denki; Curve Games; Windows; single-player; teach workerbots tasks by having them repeat actions; Scratch-style visual programming; colonists need help to survive; farming, animal husbandry, fishing, cooking, housing, tailoring.

sources.name: Banished on Steam
sources.notes: Shining Rock Software; release 2014-02-18; residents are born, age, work, start families, and die; families need available housing; twenty occupations; no money, barter with trade vessels that can bring disease; no skill or tech trees; replanting forests, mining, quarrying.

sources.name: Big Ambitions on Steam
sources.notes: Hovgaard Games; early access 2023-03-10; release date 2026-08-28; Windows and macOS. Businesses in New York City, loans, renting, staff and managers, importing from the harbour, warehouses, delivery trucks, personal needs, real estate.

sources.name: Bitburner
sources.notes: Released on Steam 2021-12-10; free to play; credited to Fulcrum Games, hydroflame, and 250+ GitHub contributors; JavaScript scripts automate play; hacking a server network; 100+ augmentations; stock market with automated trading; factions.

sources.name: Captain of Industry
sources.notes: MaFi Games; early access since 2022-05-31 with an estimated 2-4 more years as of 2026; Windows; single-player; residents need housing, water, electricity, healthcare, and household goods and generate Unity; trucks, belts, pipes, trains, and ships; world-map exploration and trade; pollution spreads disease; fully dynamic terrain; 100+ technologies.

sources.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 on Steam
sources.notes: Red Dot Games, PlayWay, 2021-08-11; over 4000 parts, 72 cars; car and salvage auctions; barn finds; tuning; skills and garage upgrade system; race track with time trial; Steam Workshop and level editor.

sources.name: Contraband Police on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2023-03-08; document count grows over time; UV flashlight vehicle search and tools to extract hidden goods; chases in upgradable police cars; post defense and inspection upgrades with rising maintenance costs; gang attacks; multiple endings.

sources.name: Dyson Sphere Program
sources.notes: Early access since 2021-01-20 and still labeled early access; star maps randomly generated per game with unique mineral distribution; planets orbit stars producing day-night cycles; Dyson shells on multiple orbits; transport ships link planets; Dark Fog attacks grow more frequent as factory activity increases.

sources.name: Equilinox on Steam
sources.notes: ThinMatrix developer and publisher; release 2018-11-23; Windows, macOS, Linux; species requirements and life cycles; healthy animals live longer, breed more, and earn diversity points; points buy genetic modifications and evolutions; tasks reward points or content; sandbox mode.

sources.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 on Steam
sources.notes: Run your own transport business; build a fleet, buy garages, hire drivers; truck tuning; Convoy online co-op; Steam Workshop and level editor.

sources.name: Farthest Frontier on Steam
sources.notes: 12 crops with rotation and soil improvement; dysentery, cholera, tetanus, rabies, frostbite, plague countered by clean water, clothing and shoes, healers, rat catchers; 19 food types, berries and greens against scurvy; town center and housing tiers from prosperity and desirability; 140+ point tech tree; prosperity draws raiders; pacifist mode.

sources.name: Foundation on Steam
sources.notes: Polymorph Games; early access 2019-02-01, full release 2025-01-31; gridless building; painting tool for home, road, patrol, and forest zones; buildings assembled from parts into monuments; production chains, taxes, trade; Estates of the Realm (Labor, Clergy, Kingdom); creative mode; full modding integration.

sources.name: Going Medieval on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2026-03-17, early access 2021-06-01; settler needs including hunger, clothing preferences, and religion; skills improved by hunting and combat; rooms such as workshops, chapels, and libraries; 3D terrain toolset to dig down and build up; raider defense with traps; research; modding tools.

sources.name: Hardspace: Shipbreaker on Steam
sources.notes: Physics-based ship cutting; laser cutter and grapple; hazards include explosive decompression, fuel, electricity, radiation; upgrades to demo charges, sensors, safety gear; campaign, free play, and timed challenge modes.

sources.name: House Flipper on Steam
sources.notes: Tools: paint roller, window cleaner, plaster tool, mop, hammer, tablet; tool use earns experience spent on tool upgrades; buy, renovate, and sell properties to buyers with requirements; Steam Workshop.

sources.name: Kenshi on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2018-12-06; squad-based sandbox RPG with no hero units; starvation, blood loss, encumbrance, and injuries affect stats; amputation and robotic limbs; slavery; outposts; research; no level scaling; dynamic world.

sources.name: Kingdoms and Castles on Steam
sources.notes: Lion Shield; 2017-07-20; each villager and resource individually simulated; layout raises happiness and attracts residents; castle blocks stack into walls and towers, taller archer towers reach farther; vikings kidnap and burn, dragon torches granaries; winter starvation, plague; Steam Workshop and level editor.

sources.name: Manor Lords on Steam
sources.notes: Early access since 2024-04-26 with no set exit date; gridless placement and rotation; burgage plots divided by roads with backyard extensions for vegetables, chickens, goats; soil fertility and crop rotation; animal populations and deforestation; seasons; production chains; traveling merchants; retinue and militia levies in real-time battles; each death is a lost townsperson.

sources.name: Mindustry
sources.notes: Steam release 2019-09-26 by AnukenDev; waves attack the core; Serpulo and Erekir campaigns with 35 hand-made maps and 250+ procedural sectors; 250+ technology blocks; launch pads move resources between sectors; coolant and lubricant boost production; Workshop maps, schematics, and mods.

sources.name: Motorsport Manager on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2016-11-09; Playsport Games; Windows, macOS, SteamOS/Linux. Build cars and parts over seasons, driver personalities, staff incl. mechanics that shorten pit stops, race strategy, pit-stop gambles, dynamic weather and tyre calls.

sources.name: Offworld Trading Company on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2016-04-28; Mohawk Games; Stardock; Windows and macOS; real-time player-driven market; multiplayer up to eight; Steam Workshop and level editor; campaign.

sources.name: Opus Magnum
sources.notes: Released 2017-12-07 by Zachtronics; programmable arms and tracks; animated GIF export of solutions; puzzle editor with Steam Workshop; curated Journal of Alchemical Engineering; Sigmar's Garden solitaire.

sources.name: Oxygen Not Included on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2019-07-30; oxygen generation and carbon dioxide buildup with an oxygen overlay; thermodynamics; gas and liquid pipes; coal, hydrogen, natural gas, and manual power with circuit overloads; colonist stress; creature ranching; procedurally generated asteroids.

sources.name: Paralives on Steam
sources.notes: Early access 2026-05-25 with about two years planned before 1.0; grid-less building, curved walls, split-level floors; needs, wants, emotions, traits, skills, careers; multiselect group actions; in-game modding interface and Steam Workshop.

sources.name: Plague Inc: Evolved on Steam
sources.notes: Released 2016-02-18; Windows, macOS, Linux; 10 disease types; body scanner; competitive and co-op multiplayer; 23 scenarios; scenario creator; Steam Workshop with over 10,000 custom scenarios; CDC asked to discuss its infection models.

sources.name: Poly Bridge on Steam
sources.notes: Release date 2016-07-12; Dry Cactus; Windows, macOS, Linux; physics bridge puzzles with resource limits; multi-phase hydraulics controller; sandbox publishing levels to Workshop; GIF replays; Steam leaderboards.

sources.name: Prison Architect on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2015-10-06; crowd flow, fires, fights, and riots; federal grants; guards, psychologists, doctors, lawyers, snitches; treatment programs and labor schedules by criminal history; Escape Mode; about 12,000 player prisons.

sources.name: Project Hospital on Steam
sources.notes: Contract with insurance companies to receive patients; examinations, lab tests, and equipment procedures as diagnostic puzzles; hire and specialize staff and manage job satisfaction; campaign, six challenge levels, sandbox; Steam Workshop.

sources.name: Project Zomboid on Steam
sources.notes: Early access since 2013-11-08; hunger, thirst, depression, boredom, illness; crafting, barricading, farming, fishing, trapping; skills from actions; vehicles; online multiplayer and split-screen; Knox County map based on Kentucky; zombies with sight and hearing; electricity failing; full Lua modding.

sources.name: Schedule I on Steam
sources.notes: TVGS; early access since 2025-03-24 with planned exit Q4 2027; Windows; production recipes, dealers, employees and suppliers for automated chains, properties, rising police pressure, rival cartels, online co-op.

sources.name: Screeps: World
sources.notes: Screeps, LLC; released 2016-11-16; Windows, macOS, Linux; 24/7 MMO world where scripts keep running offline; JavaScript plus C/C++, Rust, TypeScript, Go, and C# via WebAssembly; 20 CPU starter limit with CPU unlocks; official shards tick every 2-5 s; open-source private server.

sources.name: shapez 2
sources.notes: Release date 2026-04-23 with early access release 2024-08-15; tobspr Games with Gamirror Games; Windows, macOS, Linux; single-player.

sources.name: SnowRunner on Steam
sources.notes: Terrain reacts to truck weight, speed, and momentum; mud, water, snow, frozen lakes; snorkels and chain tires; co-op with up to 3 friends.

sources.name: Songs of Syx on Steam
sources.notes: Gamatron AB; early access 2020-09-21 with no firm 1.0 date; Windows, macOS, Linux; tens of thousands of individually simulated citizens and slaves with religion, fears, desires; multiple races; up to 50,000 units in real-time battles, each soldier needing supplies; nobles who may usurp; trade, alliances, war.

sources.name: Space Engineers on Steam
sources.notes: Volumetric physics where every block has mass, inertia, and damage; 200+ functional blocks; programmable block; power grids; oxygen and hydrogen for life support and thrusters; voxel planets with gravity; C# modding API; Steam Workshop; co-op and competitive multiplayer.

sources.name: Space Haven on Steam
sources.notes: Early access 2020-05-21, release 2026-05-13; oxygen, CO2, and hazardous gas management; thermal regulators and power nodes; crew needs (food, sleep, comfort, safety, friends), traits, relationships, and mental breaks; away missions; ship combat with cascading fire, smoke, gas, and breaches; medical scanning and surgery; generated galaxy.

sources.name: Species: Artificial Life, Real Evolution on Steam
sources.notes: Developer and publisher Quasar; Early Access release 2018-09-28, planned for about three years, no update in over three years at access; Windows; genes define each creature; offspring are randomly modified copies of one or more parents; nursery, rovers, ice age and flood events; clade diagram, satellite map, web of life, creature inspection.

sources.name: Stationeers on Steam
sources.notes: RocketWerkz; early access 2017-12-12, still early access; Windows; atmospherics with temperature, pressure, combustion, gas mixtures; explosive decompression; electrical systems; IC logic programmed in assembly; deformable voxel mining; smelters and fabricators; agriculture; co-op multiplayer; Workshop.

sources.name: Suck Up! on Steam
sources.notes: Developer and publisher Proxima; release 2025-10-01; Windows; play a vampire talking to AI townspeople with your real voice; AI responds in real time to tone and strategy; disguises; Love Bites and Mic Drop modes; Steam Workshop characters and neighborhoods; third-party AI service ChatGPT from OpenAI.

sources.name: The Farmer Was Replaced
sources.notes: Timon Herzog with publisher Metaroot; early access 2023-02-10; release 2025-10-10; Windows and macOS; drone programmed in a Python-like language stored as .py files editable externally; continuous progression with unlocks; single-player; Steam leaderboards.

sources.name: The Long Dark on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2017-08-01; Survival mode deletes the save on death; hunger, thirst, fatigue, and cold; every action costs calories; wolves, bears, and other wildlife; hypothermia, frostbite, and dysentery; 12 regions; Wintermute story mode without permadeath.

sources.name: This War of Mine on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2014-11-14; civilians in a besieged city; snipers keep survivors inside by day; one civilian scavenges at night; crafting of weapons, alcohol, beds, and stoves; trading; moral decisions; randomized world and characters.

sources.name: Timberborn on Steam
sources.notes: Mechanistry; early access 2021-09-15, release 2026-03-12; recurring droughts and toxic waste; 3D water physics with dams, floodgates, aqueducts, canals, tunnels by explosives; vertical architecture, platforms, ziplines, tubeways; sensors, relays, counters; bots; power grid; wellbeing from diet, entertainment, decorations; map editor and mods.

sources.name: Tiny Glade on Steam
sources.notes: Pounce Light; release 2024-09-23; structures assembled procedurally from strokes; a path drawn through a building makes a door; raising a building adds columns and beams; ivy grows, sheep wander paths; no management, combat, or failure states.

sources.name: Townscaper on Steam
sources.notes: Developer Oskar Stalberg, publisher Raw Fury; early access 2020-06-30; full release 2021-08-26; instant town building toy with no goal; colored blocks on an irregular grid; an algorithm turns blocks into houses, arches, stairways, bridges, and gardens.

sources.name: Universe Sandbox on Steam
sources.notes: Steam release 2015-08-24, still listed as Early Access; Giant Army; Newtonian N-body gravity; planet and star collisions; sea ice responding to axial tilt; 12 materials for building planets; supernovae and black holes.

sources.name: Valheim on Steam
sources.notes: Release 2026-09-09, early access 2021-02-02; 1 to 10 players; procedurally generated biomes; building with structural integrity and decorating for comfort; food gives boons rather than punishing; sailing; Forsaken bosses.

sources.name: Whispers from the Star on Steam
sources.notes: Developer and publisher Anuttacon; release 2025-08-14; Windows; talk with stranded astronaut Stella by voice or text; no script, open-ended conversation shapes her choices and survival; microphone required; AI-powered voiced performance created with an actor; safety filters.

sources.name: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic on Steam
sources.notes: Over 30 commodities extracted, processed, stored, and moved by tank, pipe, conveyor, truck, train, plane; construction needs delivered concrete, steel, prefab panels and workers from construction offices or imported labor; residents age, need food, clothing, alcohol; loyalty; heating demand rises in winter; flooding one bloc's market lowers returns; transit and rail signals.

sources.name: The Sims 2/Careers
sources.notes: Adult careers have ten levels, teen careers three; promotion needs three skill advances, household friends, and high mood; job performance meter driven by mood; demotion, firing after two missed days; chance cards; carpool.

sources.name: Growing 3D Artefacts and Functional Machines with Neural Cellular Automata
sources.notes: 3D-convolution NCA grows Minecraft castles, apartment blocks and trees (some over 3,000 blocks) and regrows parts of simple functional machines.

sources.name: MarioGPT: Open-Ended Text2Level Generation through Large Language Models
sources.notes: DistilGPT2 (96M parameters with cross-attention) trained on 37 path-annotated levels; 88.4% of 250 generated levels completed by an A* agent versus about 31% for an LSTM baseline; text prompts for pipes, enemies, blocks, elevation; novelty search variant.

sources.name: WorldPlay: Towards Long-Term Geometric Consistency for Real-Time Interactive World Modeling
sources.notes: 720p streaming at 24 fps; Reconstituted Context Memory and temporal reframing; Context Forcing distillation; code at Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-WorldPlay; listed as an ICML 2026 poster.

sources.name: Let Me Speak Freely? A Study on the Impact of Format Restrictions on Performance of Large Language Models
sources.notes: Requiring structured output such as JSON or XML significantly weakens reasoning compared with free-form responses; stricter formats cause larger drops.

sources.name: Decart's AI simulates a real-time, playable version of Minecraft
sources.notes: Oasis trained on Minecraft gameplay video, runs on H100s; layout forgotten after turning around; Decart did not say it had Microsoft's permission for the footage; $21M seed.

sources.name: I built marshmallow castles in Google's new AI world generator Project Genie
sources.notes: Project Genie for US Google AI Ultra subscribers; Genie 3 plus Nano Banana Pro; 60-second cap due to compute; characters walk through walls; controls sometimes unresponsive; copyrighted worlds refused.

sources.name: Hunyuan-GameCraft-1.0 model card
sources.notes: Inference code and weights released 2025-08-14; minimum 24 GB GPU memory (very slow), 80 GB recommended; tested on 8 GPUs; distilled model uses 8 steps.

sources.name: Hunyuan3D 2.0: Scaling Diffusion Models for High Resolution Textured 3D Assets Generation
sources.notes: Hunyuan3D-DiT flow-based shape diffusion transformer and Hunyuan3D-Paint texture synthesis; code and weights public (github.com/Tencent/Hunyuan3D-2); Hunyuan3D-Studio production platform.

sources.name: Hunyuan3D-2.1 repository
sources.notes: Released 2025-06-13 as 'production-ready'; PBR texture synthesis; full weights and training code; VRAM about 10 GB shape, 21 GB texture, 29 GB both.

sources.name: HunyuanWorld 1.0: Generating Immersive, Explorable, and Interactive 3D Worlds from Words or Pixels
sources.notes: Panoramic world proxies lifted to a semantically layered 3D mesh; mesh export for graphics pipelines; game development listed as an application.

sources.name: Yan: Foundational Interactive Video Generation
sources.notes: Trained on the 3D game Yuan Meng Star; Yan-Sim 1080p 50-60 fps with ~0.07 s latency; Yan-Gen 12-17 fps on one H20, ~30 fps on 4; editing module separates mechanics simulation from rendering and supports text edits during interaction.

sources.name: MaskedMimic: Unified Physics-Based Character Control Through Masked Motion Inpainting
sources.notes: Motion inpainting formulation; one controller from keyframes, objects, text, VR head and hand signals; object interaction with chairs, stools, sofas; terrain transfer; path following and steering; code in NVlabs/ProtoMotions.

authors: The Farmer Was Replaced Wiki contributors
sources.name: Leaderboard
sources.notes: Leaderboards (fastest reset, maze, dinosaur, per-crop targets, single drone on an 8x8 farm) run the player's program as fixed-start simulations totaling at least 2 hours; the score is the average time of successful runs.

authors: The Farmer Was Replaced Wiki contributors
sources.name: Operation Costs
sources.notes: Each operation costs ticks: literals and assignment free, arithmetic and getters 1, a successful move() 200, a failed fallible action 1; tick costs scale with the speed factor while print() and do_a_flip() take fixed real time.

authors: The Farmer Was Replaced Wiki contributors
sources.name: Polyculture
sources.notes: Grass, bushes, trees, and carrots request a different companion plant at a tile within 3 moves, read with get_companion(); planting it multiplies yield (5x before upgrades, doubled per upgrade).

authors: The Farmer Was Replaced Wiki contributors
sources.name: Sunflowers
sources.notes: Sunflowers have 7 to 15 petals; harvested power makes the drone run twice as fast and is used at 1 per 30 actions; with at least 10 sunflowers, harvesting one with the most petals yields 8 times the power.

authors: The Farmer Was Replaced Wiki contributors
sources.name: Unlocks
sources.notes: Unlocks include Expand, Speed, Megafarm (more drones), Polyculture, Mazes, Dinosaurs, Leaderboard, Watering, Fertilizer, and language features such as Loops, Variables, Functions, Lists, Dictionaries, and Operators.

sources.name: NVIDIA open-sources PhysX's GPU simulation code
sources.notes: PhysX 5.6 and Flow 2.2 GPU source released under BSD-3 with over 500 CUDA kernels; previously GPU support shipped as binaries only; Unreal Engine 5 uses Chaos instead.

sources.name: Mirage 2 allows users to turn sketches and photos into interactive game worlds
sources.notes: Dynamics Lab Mirage 2 launched about 2025-08-21; players change worlds in real time by typed commands; worlds can be saved and shared; struggles with precise controls and visual stability relative to Genie 3.

sources.name: How Townscaper Works: A Story Four Games in the Making
sources.notes: Irregular quad grid from a subdivided, jittered hex grid; marching-cubes-style corner modules; real-time wave function collapse narrows modules per cell; decoration applied after; gardens only in enclosed areas; may fail silently; delay grows with structure size; described as a mixed-initiative system.

sources.name: Breath of the Wild, science, and clever little lies
sources.notes: Coverage of Takuhiro Dohta's GDC 2017 chemistry engine segment: elements (fire, water, ice, wind, electricity) change materials' states, elements change each other's states, and materials cannot change each other's states.

sources.name: Level Generation Through Large Language Models
GAVEL: Generating Games Via Evolution and Language Models
sources.notes: CodeLlama-13b fine-tuned (fill-in-the-middle, about 40 h on one RTX8000) on 574 Ludii games as the mutation operator in MAP-Elites over a PCA of 510-dimensional Ludii concept vectors (1,600 cells); fitness from compile and playability checks, random playouts, and MCTS self-play balance, decisiveness, completion, agency, coverage, and strategic depth.

sources.name: Assessing Game Balance with AlphaZero: Exploring Alternative Rule Sets in Chess
sources.notes: AlphaZero trained from scratch on nine rule variants of chess to compare decisiveness, piece values, and dynamism as an in silico balance assessment.

sources.name: The Surprising Number of Steam Games that Use GenAI
sources.notes: About 1,000 Steam games disclosed generative AI in the Content Survey by April 2024; informal categories (character art, backgrounds, concept art, UI, store art, voice and audio, narrative, artist tools).

sources.name: Games With AI Disclosures Have Grossed an Estimated $660M on Steam
sources.notes: 10,258 games with AI disclosures (about 8% of Steam); about $660M estimated combined gross by review count x price x 35; 12 eight-figure, 33 seven-figure, 170 six-figure, 487 five-figure, 9,556 below.

sources.name: The NEW Surprising Number of Steam Games that Use GenAI
sources.notes: 7,818 Steam titles with generative AI disclosures, about 7% of about 114,126; about 1.1% a year earlier; a little under 20% of 2025 releases; visual assets in about 60% of disclosures. Lower bound, voluntary disclosures, counted via Steam API.

sources.name: Prom Week Released on Facebook!
sources.notes: Author archive page holding the 2012-02-14 release post (Facebook, 18 high school students, the week before prom) and the 2012-02-21 Social Exchanges post (over 5,000 social considerations).

sources.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 (Truck Simulator Wiki)
sources.notes: Community wiki: player must earn at least 100,000 euros or take a bank loan before buying a first truck; recruitment agencies supply NPC drivers; service shops; VR available only as an experimental Steam beta branch.

sources.name: With 100K copies sold in less than 2 weeks, this Steam game could be the next Papers, Please
sources.notes: Compares Contraband Police to a 3D version of Papers, Please; over 100,000 sales within days of release.

sources.name: Ubisoft La Forge produces a data-driven physics simulation based on machine learning
sources.notes: Studio summary of Holden et al. 2019: runs 300 to 5000 times faster than conventional physics simulation at small additional memory cost.

sources.name: Introducing Learned Motion Matching
sources.notes: Decompressor, Stepper, Projector networks replace motion matching databases; ~10x less memory on path following; 590 MB controller to ~17 MB, 8.5 MB quantized (~70x); constant CPU cost; nearly identical output.

sources.name: Diffusion Models Are Real-Time Game Engines
sources.notes: GameNGen: DOOM at 20 fps on one TPU-v5; PSNR 29.43; raters 58%/60% on 1.6 s/3.2 s clips; 64-frame context (~3 s); trained on 70M frames from a PPO agent (50M env steps); 128 TPU-v5e for training; limitations: memory, heuristic errors, no game creation.

sources.name: Building
sources.notes: Stability from blue (grounded) to red; falls with horizontal and vertical distance; a piece cannot exceed its support's stability; vertical limits 16 m for wood and stone, 24 m for core wood; uncovered wood decays to 50% durability; trees and boulders count as ground.

sources.name: AI Content on Steam
sources.notes: Valve announced a new process that lets it release the vast majority of games that use AI, replacing its earlier pause while it studied the legal questions; the disclosure details are in the Content Survey documentation.

sources.name: Steamworks Documentation: Content Survey (generative AI disclosure)
sources.notes: Covers AI content shipped to players, not development-efficiency tools. Pre-Generated content reviewed like other content; Live-Generated content must also describe guardrails against illegal output. Live-generated AI adult-only sexual content not permitted. Lists ways to fund ongoing AI service costs (base price, microtransactions, subscription, DLC).

sources.name: Generative agent-based modeling with actions grounded in physical, social, or digital space using Concordia
sources.notes: Agents state intended actions in natural language; a Game Master agent, inspired by tabletop RPGs, decides outcomes, checks physical plausibility, and can call digital tools. Behavior comes from components mediating LLM calls and associative memory retrieval.

sources.name: Multi-Actor Generative Artificial Intelligence as a Game Engine
sources.notes: Entity-Component pattern for Concordia: the Game Master is a configurable entity built from components; separates engineers (components) from designers (scenarios). Classifies multi-actor uses as Simulationist, Dramatist, and Evaluationist.

sources.name: Improving Conditional Level Generation using Automated Validation in Match-3 Games
sources.notes: EA SEED cVAE conditioned on size, symmetry, and difficulty (median moves of a scripted bot over 30 plays); 51.39% valid levels versus 46.15% in the dataset; difficulty accuracy 33.33%, mean gap 10.19 moves.

sources.name: Fluctuations in the Abundance of a Species considered Mathematically
sources.notes: Volterra's predator-prey equations, independently of Lotka; prey grow and are consumed in proportion to encounters with predators, predators grow from consumption and die at a constant rate, producing persistent oscillations.

sources.name: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET): Endlessly Generating Increasingly Complex and Diverse Learning Environments and Their Solutions
Enhanced POET: Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning through Unbounded Invention of Learning Challenges and their Solutions
Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
sources.notes: Automatic curriculum, skill library of executable code, iterative prompting with environment feedback, execution errors, and self-verification; GPT-4. 3.3x unique items, 2.3x distance, tech-tree milestones up to 15.3x faster; 63 items in 160 iterations; GPT-4 15x cost of GPT-3.5; GPT-3.5 code gen 5.7x fewer items; hallucinated tasks (copper sword) and nonexistent API calls.

sources.name: Can Language Models Serve as Text-Based World Simulators?
sources.notes: ByteSized32-State-Prediction: 76,369 transitions from 31 text games. GPT-4 whole-state accuracy at most 59.9%; action-driven up to 77.1%; environment-driven at most 49.7%; humans about 80% on a subset where GPT-4 averaged about 50%. Failures in arithmetic, common sense, scientific knowledge.

sources.name: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
sources.notes: 720p up to 40 fps with a 5B model on an 8+1 GPU setup; 2x14B scaled model; camera-aware memory retrieval by pose and field-of-view overlap; minute-long consistency; DMD distillation, quantization, VAE decoder pruning.

sources.name: Biological homeostasis of the global environment: the parable of Daisyworld
sources.notes: Daisyworld model: black and white daisies with different albedo regulate planetary temperature across a range of stellar luminosity without foresight, illustrating biosphere-climate feedback.

sources.name: A Tale in the Desert
sources.notes: eGenesis; First Telling launched 2003-02-15; later Pluribus Games and Desert Nomad Studios. Windows, Linux, Mac. No combat; Tellings average about 18 months and end in a wipe; seven tests per discipline leading to Oracle rank and Monuments; laws by petition with signatures then a vote, a controlled variant of Nomic; elected Demi-Pharaoh can ban up to seven characters; no official currency; gathering wood, mining, flax.

sources.name: Against the Storm (video game)
sources.notes: Eremite Games, Hooded Horse; early access October 2021; Windows 2023-12-08; consoles 2025-06-26; each run is a short settlement map; Reputation gauge versus Queen's Impatience; seven species, three per village; villagers leave when discontented; blight and corruption; seal fragments; storm destroys settlements and a new map is generated; over a million Steam copies by May 2024.

sources.name: AI Dungeon
sources.notes: Latitude; 2019 release, AI Dungeon 2 in December 2019 on GPT-2 (1.5B), GPT-3 from July 2020; Do, Say, Story, See inputs; player-set memory; criticism of forgetting earlier content; 2021 moderation filter with false positives.

sources.name: Animal Crossing
sources.notes: Series uses the console's internal clock and calendar so game time matches real time; some events and tree growth require real time to pass; hourly music; original Dobutsu no Mori on Nintendo 64, 14 April 2001.

sources.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
sources.notes: Nintendo EPD, Switch release 2020-03-20, Switch 2 edition 2026-01-15; real-time clock with hemisphere seasons, D.I.Y. crafting, Nook Miles, museum, island rating, Island Designer, reduced bank interest to deter time travel, 4 local and 8 online players.

sources.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana
sources.notes: Ubisoft Mainz, Ubisoft; PS5, Windows, Xbox Series 2025-11-13; Latium or Albion starts; tiers from Liberti to Patricians; optional categorized needs; goods attributes; adjacency effects of production buildings; diagonal placement; paved roads extend range; belief and gods; schools generate research for 100+ unlocks; modular ships; co-op; mod loader at launch.

sources.name: Anno 1800
sources.notes: Ubisoft Blue Byte, Ubisoft; Windows 2019-04-16; Console Edition PS5 and Xbox Series 2023-03-16; Old World and New World sessions linked by trade routes; citizen needs drive production chains; AI rivals on the same map; naval warfare; attractiveness and tourism lowered by factories and pollution; blueprint mode; multiplayer.

sources.name: ARC Raiders
sources.notes: Released 2025-10-30 by Embark Studios; AI text-to-speech voice lines criticized and debated; 4M copies by 2025-11-11, 14M by 2026-02; Embark CEO said in 2026-03 some AI voice lines were re-recorded by human actors.

sources.name: Arma 3
sources.notes: Bohemia Interactive. Alpha 2013-03-05 on Steam Early Access, full release 2013-09-12 (Windows); macOS and Linux 2015. Weapons affected by external ballistics and recoil; carried weight reduces speed and stamina; combat vehicles, helicopters, jets, boats, diving; Eden 3D editor (2016); SQF scripting; Steam Workshop modding; terrains Tanoa 100 km2, Malden 57 km2, Livonia 163 km2; military consultants wrote after-action reports for Tac-Ops.

sources.name: Artificial intelligence in video games
sources.notes: Steam requires disclosure of pre-generated and live-generated AI content (January 2024). ARC Raiders (Nov 2025) criticized and marked down by Eurogamer for generative AI NPC voices. SAG-AFTRA video game strike July 2024 to July 2025 ended with AI voice consent terms. Players criticized apparently AI-generated dialogue in Where Winds Meet. Infinite Craft uses LLaMA.

sources.name: Autonauts (Denki article)
sources.notes: Covered in the article on Denki (Dundee, founded 2000 by former DMA Design staff): Autonauts public demo on itch.io 2017-07-05; Steam PC release October 2019 published by Curve Digital; Autonauts vs. Piratebots released 2022-07-28.

sources.name: Balance of Power (video game)
sources.notes: Chris Crawford, Mindscape; Macintosh 1985 (infobox November, body September); ports to MS-DOS, Amiga, Atari ST, Apple II, PC-88, PC-98, MSX, Windows. Player leads US or USSR for eight one-year turns, maximizes prestige points, answers crises with no action, diplomatic notes, or military maneuvers; backing down costs prestige; escalation can trigger nuclear war, which ends the game. Compared with Ketchledge's Geopolitique 1990.

sources.name: Banished (video game)
sources.notes: Shining Rock Software, Luke Hodorowicz; Windows 2014-02-18; citizens are the primary resource; workplace assignment; aging, births, nomads; fire and starvation hazards; mod support from patch 1.04 (November 2014); Anno series cited as a big inspiration, combat left out.

sources.name: BeamNG.drive
sources.notes: BeamNG GmbH; tech demo and paid alpha 2013-08-03, Steam Early Access 2015-05-29; JBeam node-and-beam soft-body vehicles; damage to engines, doors, windows, tires, fuel tanks; free roam, campaigns, time trials; Lua mods via official repository; BeamNG.tech research fork; PS5 version scheduled for 2026-10-19 with version 0.40.

sources.name: Besiege (video game)
sources.notes: Spiderling Studios; early access 2015-01-28; full release 2020-02-18; PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, mobile (2025); 55 campaign levels on four islands; logic blocks (timers, gates, sensors); PC multiplayer and level editor added December 2017; Splintered Sea expansion adds water physics.

sources.name: Big Pharma (video game)
sources.notes: Twice Circled, Tim Wicksteed, Positech Games, 2015-08-27 PC; Xbox One, Switch, PS4 2019. Ingredient effects active in concentration windows on a 0-20 scale; machines and conveyor belts; letter grade from effectiveness, side effects, demand; market saturation by rivals; research tree; explorers find ingredients.

sources.name: Black & White (video game)
sources.notes: Lionhead Studios, released 2001-03-27; worshipping villagers generate power for miracles; miracles selected at the Temple or Village Centre or cast by gestures with the Hand; the creature learns from responses to its actions.

sources.name: Caesar III
sources.notes: Released 1998-09-30 by Impressions Games; inhabitants provide services to buildings by walking past them, adding strategy to road pathing.

sources.name: Cai Haoyu
sources.notes: Formed the California-based startup Anuttacon in late 2023; Whispers from the Star announced in 2025 as its first game.

sources.name: Capitalism (video game)
sources.notes: 1995, Enlight, Trevor Chan; rivals with adjustable competence and managerial style; buyout threat; optional stock market; R&D raises product quality.

sources.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2018
sources.notes: Red Dot Games; players examine engine, suspension, and chassis, remove parts in a realistic order to reach damaged ones, buy or repair parts, test track for brake and suspension problems; sequel Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 released 2021-08-11.

sources.name: Cities: Skylines
sources.notes: Colossal Order, Paradox Interactive; Windows, macOS, Linux 2015-03-10; Xbox One and PS4 2017, Switch 2018; zoning grid follows roads; districts and policies; power, water, sewage; citizens take the fastest route; buses, trams, trains, ferries, metro; population milestones unlock services and up to 25 map tiles; Steam Workshop; Cities in Motion lineage; approved after SimCity (2013) reception.

sources.name: Cities: Skylines II
sources.notes: Windows 2023-10-24; Colossal Order until a November 2025 handover, Iceflake Studios from 2026; console versions delayed indefinitely in July 2024 with no date as of late 2026; route choice by length, cost, comfort, preference; 9 to 441 map tiles; development points tech tree; preset climates and seasons; one day-night cycle equals one month; Paradox Mods from 2024-03-25.

sources.name: City-building game
sources.notes: Genre history: The Sumerian Game adapted into The Sumer Game (Hamurabi); Utopia as the first sim game; genre established in 1989 with SimCity; Caesar began the Impressions historical series; Banished kick-started the survival city-builder trend; Cities: Skylines revived the SimCity style.

sources.name: Civilization (video game)
sources.notes: MicroProse, September 1991; Sid Meier and Bruce Shelley. MS-DOS, Amiga, Atari ST, PC-98, Windows, Macintosh, SNES, PlayStation, Saturn. Turn-based 4X from 4000 BC to AD 2100 against two to seven AI civs; one advance researched at a time; one-per-world wonders; barbarians; conquest or space-race victory. Influences: Tresham's Civilization board game, Empire, SimCity, Railroad Tycoon, Populous.

sources.name: Command: Modern Operations
sources.notes: Warfare Sims, Matrix Games; operational control of units on a map of Earth; missions or direct orders; scenarios hours to days with time acceleration; DB3000 and Cold War platform databases; Professional Edition with database editing and Monte Carlo analysis (article release date 2013 refers to the predecessor Command: Modern Air/Naval Operations).

sources.name: Contraband Police
sources.notes: Crazy Rocks Studios, PlayWay, Unity; Windows March 2023, PS5 and Xbox Series 2025-11-07; 1981 Acaristan; document checks, contraband search, chases, field missions, border raids; free prologue demo about two years earlier.

sources.name: Conway's Game of Life
sources.notes: Devised by John Horton Conway; first published in Martin Gardner's Scientific American column, October 1970; B3/S23 rule, simultaneous update, zero-player; Turing complete; R-pentomino 1,103 generations; Gosper glider gun (November 1970, period 30); first interactive program on a PDP-7; Golly with Hashlife and Lua or Python scripting.

sources.name: Corrupted Blood incident
sources.notes: World of Warcraft, 13 September to 8 October 2005; Hakkar's Corrupted Blood debuff (263-337 damage every two seconds, spreads to nearby characters, no immunity) escaped Zul'Gurub via suspended pets and fast travel to cities; quarantines partly bypassed; servers hard-reset after about a week; pets made immune on 8 October.

sources.name: Creatures (1996 video game)
sources.notes: Windows and Mac release EU November 1996, NA July 1997; PlayStation 2001-2002; Game Boy Advance 2002; Norns learn through neural networks; every copy shipped a unique starting set of egg genomes; Grendels; Life Kit expansion; sales near 400,000 by February 1998.

sources.name: Creatures (video game series)
sources.notes: Created by Steve Grand at Millennium Interactive; haploid genetics with no dominance and no recombination between loci; simulated biochemistry and organs; neural-network brain with one sight neuron group per object type; drive-reduction learning; word teaching and typed instructions; lifespan about 40 hours; Grendels carry disease; online Norn-swapping community.

sources.name: Crusader Kings III
sources.notes: Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive. PC 2020-09-01; PS5 and Xbox Series 2022-03-29. Start dates 867, 1066, 1178; ends 1453. Play continues with the heir on death; game ends without a viable heir; dynasty Renown. Six skills; personality, education, and genetic traits; stress from acting against traits can be lethal; six lifestyles with three skill trees each; prestige, gold, piety; levies, men-at-arms, knights.

sources.name: DCS World
sources.notes: Eagle Dynamics; study sim with interactive cockpit switches; subsystems such as engines, fuel, electrical, hydraulic, radios modeled; used by the USAF 355th Training Squadron as an A-10C instrument and weapons-systems trainer.

sources.name: Deep Learning Super Sampling
sources.notes: Versions 1.0 (2019) to 4.5 (2026-01) and 5.0 (announced 2026-03, available 2026-09); 540+ DLSS titles 2025-01; 250+ MFG 2026-01; frame generation adds latency and artifacts; DLSS 5 negative reception and reported 50-60% frame-rate cost.

sources.name: Democracy 4
sources.notes: Positech series release dates; neural-network-based logic in CSV files; overlapping voter factions; political capital; two pre-election promises and cynicism; situations; tax evasion at high taxes.

sources.name: Don't Starve
sources.notes: Klei Entertainment; beta 2012, release 2013-04-23 for Windows, OS X, Linux, later PlayStation, Wii U, Xbox One, iOS, Android, Switch; hunger, health, and sanity meters; below 15% sanity figments attack; 8-minute days; Charlie attacks in darkness; spoilage; permadeath except rare items; random worlds; Don't Starve Together.

sources.name: Dwarf Fortress
sources.notes: World generation with midpoint-displacement elevation, rainfall, drainage, temperature, erosion-traced rivers, and rain shadows; history simulated for a player-chosen number of years; Legends mode and XML export; Tarn Adams calls the game a story generator; Steam release 2022-12-06.

sources.name: Dyson Sphere Program
sources.notes: Youthcat Studio, published by Gamera Games; Windows early access 2021-01-21; single-player; drones move resources between factories across a star system; research matrices consumed by labs; Rise of the Dark Fog update (December 2023) added a hostile faction; developers drew inspiration from Stellaris Dyson spheres; 1.7 million sold by September 2021.

sources.name: Eco (2018 video game)
sources.notes: Strange Loop Games; early access 2018-02-06; players form governments and propose and vote on laws that restrict actions or apply taxes and grants; ecosystem damage from overharvest and pollution.

sources.name: Elite (video game)
sources.notes: David Braben and Ian Bell; Acornsoft, BBC Micro, September 1984; eight procedurally generated galaxies from seeds; 7 light-year hyperspace limit by fuel; trading, piracy, bounty hunting, combat rating to Elite; credited with defining space trading genre; lists influenced titles including EVE Online.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous
sources.notes: Frontier Developments; backer alpha December 2013; full release 2014-12-16 (Windows); Xbox One 2015, PS4 2017; VR support; Stellar Forge 1:1 Milky Way of ~400 billion systems; Background Simulation of factions and economies; Powerplay (2015); Solo, Private Group, Open modes; Odyssey 2021.

sources.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2
sources.notes: SCS Software, Prism3D; Windows 2012-10-18, Linux 2013, macOS 2015; timed deliveries with pay reduced by damage; fuel, tolls, repair costs; buy trucks, trailers, garages, hire AI drivers; skill points unlock ADR, fragile, urgent jobs; 71 cities in 12 countries; TruckersMP mod 2013, official multiplayer 2021; over 22 million sold by 2026.

sources.name: Europa Universalis IV
sources.notes: Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive, August 2013 (infobox 13, body 25); Windows, OS X, Linux. Over 500 playable nations, 1444 to 1821, no strict win condition. Administrative, diplomatic, and military monarch power buys technology; institutions spread by province; trade nodes and merchants; alliances, vassals, coalitions; estates; random and historical events; Ironman mode.

sources.name: Eve Online
sources.notes: Single-universe MMO on the Tranquility server, taken offline daily for maintenance; player-driven economy; real-time skill training while offline; corporations with CEO and roles, member taxes, weekly-fee war declarations, alliances claiming null-sec sovereignty; Bloodbath of B-R5RB lasted 21 hours; CCP Games, 2003-05-06.

sources.name: Façade (video game)
sources.notes: Michael Mateas and Andrew Stern, Procedural Arts; free Windows release 2005-07-05, Mac 2006; typed natural language input, A Behavior Language, drama manager, three endings, player can be removed.

sources.name: Factorio
sources.notes: Wube Software (Prague), developed since mid-2012; Indiegogo campaign 2013-01-31 to 2013-03-03; downloadable from the official site early in development; Steam early access 2016-02-25; 1.0 on 2020-08-14; Space Age expansion 2024-10-21; Nintendo Switch 2022-10-28; co-op and competitive multiplayer; Lua mods via mod portal; lead designer Michal Kovarik cited the Minecraft mods IndustrialCraft and BuildCraft; 3.5 million sold by December 2022.

sources.name: Farming Simulator
sources.notes: Series article: FS25 released 2024-11-12; dynamically generated missions, seasonal cycle and production chains since FS22, multiplayer since FS2013, modding since FS2009, PC and console platforms.

sources.name: Farthest Frontier
sources.notes: Crate Entertainment; early access 2022-08-09; 1.0 on 2025-10-23; Windows; soil fertility, crop rotation, rock and weed removal; cholera, scurvy, dysentery, bubonic plague; varied diets; raiders and wildlife; walls, towers, barracks.

sources.name: FIFA 22
sources.notes: HyperMotion: 22 players in mocap suits for a full match; ML algorithm using over 8.7 million frames of match capture generates animation in real time; PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Stadia only.

sources.name: Fog of war
sources.notes: Video game section: Walter Bright's Empire (1977) credited as earliest use; Tanktics (1978); Warcraft and StarCraft reveal through reconnaissance with previously seen areas keeping terrain but not unit changes; AI given full map knowledge seen as cheating.

sources.name: Football Manager
sources.notes: Series article: Sports Interactive, Sega; relaunch after the Eidos split; platforms PC, mobile, PSP, Xbox 360, Switch; researcher database; scout knowledge; 2D engine 2005, 3D engine 2009; tactics, transfers, finances, board, press conferences; Everton use of the database 2008.

sources.name: Football Manager 2005
sources.notes: First Football Manager, released in Europe 2004-11-04/05; built on Championship Manager 4 code; Windows and Mac OS X; single player plus TCP/IP and hot-seat multiplayer; board judges performance.

sources.name: Foundation (video game)
sources.notes: Polymorph Games; early access 2019-02-01; full release 2025-01-31; Windows; gridless organic placement; trade with neighboring villages; villagers assigned to jobs; progression through tiers guided by a book.

sources.name: From Dust
sources.notes: Ubisoft Montpellier, designed by Eric Chahi; Xbox Live Arcade 2011-07-27, Windows 2011-08-17, PSN 2011-09, Chrome 2012-05-23; lava cools to rock, water erodes, vegetation spreads; the Breath cursor; totems and villages; tsunami and eruption warnings; spiritual successor to Populous.

sources.name: Frostpunk
sources.notes: 2018, 11 bit studios; Hope and Discontent meters; Book of Laws with sequenced laws and escalating compromises; revolt ends the game when hope is too low or discontent too high for too long.

sources.name: Frostpunk 2
sources.notes: 2024, 11 bit studios; council of 100 faction-affiliated members votes on laws; 51 votes for most laws, two thirds for laws granting the Steward more power; negotiation by promises; faction tension can reach civil war.

sources.name: FTL: Faster Than Light
sources.notes: Eight procedurally generated sectors of about twenty beacons with events and choices; rebel fleet advances with each jump; save deleted when the ship is destroyed or crew lost; Subset Games, 2012-09-14.

sources.name: Game Dev Tycoon
sources.notes: Greenheart Games, 2012-12-10; Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Switch 2020. Garage start in the 1980s, engines, console licenses, offices, staff, R&D and Hardware labs; JavaScript gdt-modAPI mods; inspired by Game Dev Story; piracy stunt with in-game bankruptcy.

sources.name: Garry's Mod
sources.notes: Facepunch Studios, Garry Newman; Source engine mod released 2004-12-24; standalone on Steam 2006-11-29 (Valve); Windows, macOS, Linux; physics gun, tool gun welds and constraints; Lua addons; gamemodes TTT, Prop Hunt, DarkRP, Wiremod; 25.5 million sold by 2024.

sources.name: Gaussian splatting
sources.notes: Training about 35-45 min vs about 48 h for Mip-NeRF 360; higher memory than NeRF; peak training memory over 20 GB; splotchy and popping artifacts; dynamic (4D) variants.

sources.name: Genie (AI model)
sources.notes: Version history: Genie 2024-03, Genie 2 2024-12 (360p, 10-20 s), Genie 3 2025-08 (720p, 24 fps, one-minute memory); Waymo World Model built on Genie 3 (2026-02) for driving edge cases.

sources.name: Going Medieval
sources.notes: Foxy Voxel, published by Mythwright; early access 2021-06-01, 1.0 2026-03-17; Windows; voxel terrain with cellars and multi-level fortifications; settler traits, skills, perks, needs, and moods; seasons; bandit raids; compared to RimWorld and Dwarf Fortress.

sources.name: Gran Turismo (1997 video game)
sources.notes: Polys Entertainment (Polyphony Digital from 1998), Sony; PlayStation, Japan 1997-12-23; license tests gate Simulation mode events; credits buy cars, parts, tuning; 140 cars, 11 tracks; first DualShock-designed game; 10.85 million sold; IGN: grandfather of modern console racing sims.

sources.name: Hamurabi (video game)
sources.notes: Doug Dyment, 1968, FOCAL on PDP-8; each round is a year: adviser report, then grain for land at 17-26 bushels per acre, seed, and food; random harvest, rats, immigration, plague halving population; game ends if 45% starve in a round; 10 rounds.

sources.name: Hardspace: Shipbreaker
sources.notes: Blackbird Interactive; laser cutter, tether, scanner; cutting electrical wires or coolant pipes can explode; decompression; reactor meltdown timer; debt of $1.2 billion; early access 2020-06-16, full release 2022-05-24.

sources.name: Harvest Moon (video game)
sources.notes: Developer Amccus (Pack-In-Soft team of 8-10), Super Famicom Japan 1996-08-09 as Bokujo Monogatari; daily watering, livestock care rules, bar open after dark, wife added as a goal; director Yasuhiro Wada's three principles.

sources.name: Hearts of Iron IV
sources.notes: Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive, 2016-06-06; Windows, macOS, Linux. Start dates 1936-01-01 and 1939-08-14. National focus trees (initially unique for Germany, UK, USSR, US); civilian and military factories and dockyards; political power for laws and ministers; four ideologies; supply affects combat; weather in sea and air regions; world tension 0 to 100; tank, ship, and plane designers added by DLC.

sources.name: House Flipper
sources.notes: Empyrean; Frozen District and PlayWay; 2018-05-17 PC, PS4/Xbox One 2020-02, Switch 2020-06; painting, tiling, cleaning, demolition, furnishing; email jobs paid by size and quality; buyers with different needs bid at auction; Garden Flipper DLC scores gardens to raise sale price.

sources.name: Infinite Craft
sources.notes: Neal Agarwal (neal.fun); web 2024-01-31, iOS April 2024, Android 2024-05-21; starts from water, fire, wind, earth; pair looked up in a database, new pairs generated by Llama 2 and Llama 3.1 with emoji and stored so all players get the same result; First Discovery label; twenty-token cap.

sources.name: inZOI
sources.notes: inZOI Studio, Krafton; Windows early access 2025-03-28, macOS 2025-08-20, PS5 delayed to early 2027; eight needs, karma system, cities Dowon, Bliss Bay, Kucingku; official mod support added May 2025.

sources.name: iRacing
sources.notes: Released 2008-08-26; Dave Kaemmer and John W. Henry; built from NASCAR Racing 2003 Season code with new tire model; LIDAR-scanned cars and tracks; subscription; Rookie to A licenses; no-blame Safety Rating; Elo-style iRating; 13-week seasons with weekly track rotation; eNASCAR iRacing Series.

sources.name: Islanders (video game)
sources.notes: Grizzly Games (Coatsink from 2022); Windows 2019-04-04; Switch, PS4, Xbox One 2021; Meta Quest 2023; buildings score points from proximity to compatible structures and lose points for incompatible ones; placements are permanent; point thresholds offer a choice of two building packs; filling the gauge unlocks a new island; no resources, traffic, or research; global leaderboard only.

sources.name: Job Simulator
sources.notes: Owlchemy Labs; Windows 2016-04-05 (HTC Vive launch), PS4 2016-10-13, Quest 2019, PS5 2023, visionOS 2024; museum of jobs run by job bots; Office Worker, Gourmet Chef, Store Clerk, Auto Mechanic; most objects can be picked up; over 1 million sold.

sources.name: Jurassic World Evolution
sources.notes: Frontier Developments, 2018-06-12 PC/PS4/Xbox One, Switch 2020. Fossil expeditions, DNA sequencing and genome modification, feeding and social needs, Science/Security/Entertainment divisions with contracts and sabotage, storms, power failures, breakouts, ACU and rangers, five-island career.

sources.name: Kenshi (video game)
sources.notes: Lo-Fi Games; Chris Hunt worked alone until 2013; one of the first Steam Early Access games in March 2013; full release 2018-12-06; Windows; limbs damaged or severed and replaced with prosthetics; skills level through actions; world states react to deaths of notable figures.

sources.name: Kerbal Space Program
sources.notes: Squad (Mexico); first public release 0.7.3 on 2011-06-24; Steam early access 2013-03-20; 1.0 on 2015-04-27; Linux, macOS, Windows, PS4/PS5, Xbox; patched-conic orbits (no n-body); sandbox, science, and career modes with funds, reputation, contracts; joint strength limits; 3,000+ mods.

sources.name: Kingdoms and Castles
sources.notes: Lion Shield; Linux, macOS, Windows 2017-07-20; Xbox 2023-12-01; PlayStation 2024-03-21; peasants farm, build, cut lumber; taxes; dragons, vikings, and ogres attack; annual winter destroys crops, lightning fires, plagues; diplomats, alliances, trade, war with AI kingdoms.

sources.name: Left 4 Dead
sources.notes: The AI Director places infected and items based on each player's situation, status, skill, and location, uses music and effects to build tension; Valve calls it procedural narrative; released 2008-11-18.

sources.name: Lemonade Stand
sources.notes: 1973 MECC (Bob Jamison, attribution flagged), Apple II port 1979; daily inputs are glasses made, signs, and price per glass; weather report; storms void profits; 12 days.

sources.name: Little Computer People
sources.notes: Designers Rich Gold and David Crane, Activision; C64 release 1985-09-27 and later ports; six-hour real-time day, 256 names, typed commands, no win condition; Will Wright played it.

sources.name: Manor Lords
sources.notes: Slavic Magic (Greg Styczen), Hooded Horse; Windows early access 2024-04-26, still early access with Major Update 8 in August 2026; curved roads and gridless housing; six tax types, yearly King's tax, tithes; soil exhaustion and deforestation; retinue, mercenaries, armed villagers; bandits; AI lords; over 4 million copies by August 2026.
